description: The records the Iceland-today opening (src/models/iceland/today) reads, copied from the dated snapshot by scripts/extract-today.ts, and the committed solution of its start solve. Edit the snapshot, not this file; rerun the script to refresh it.

records.label: Full current account / rolling GDP
records.notes: Four rounded CBI quarter balances divided by Hagstofa four-quarter GDP of ISK 5,138.861 bn. The observed external balance is negative; the stationary model solves it to zero.

records.label: Aluminium export receipts
records.notes: Tourism is travel plus passenger transport. Other is total minus marine products, aluminium, and foreign travellers; it includes non-aluminium manufacturing. Values do not identify export volumes, capacity or foreign-currency unit prices.

records.label: Marine products export receipts
records.notes: Tourism is travel plus passenger transport. Other is total minus marine products, aluminium, and foreign travellers; it includes non-aluminium manufacturing. Values do not identify export volumes, capacity or foreign-currency unit prices.

records.label: Other sectors export receipts
records.notes: Tourism is travel plus passenger transport. Other is total minus marine products, aluminium, and foreign travellers; it includes non-aluminium manufacturing. Values do not identify export volumes, capacity or foreign-currency unit prices.

records.label: Tourism export receipts
records.notes: Tourism is travel plus passenger transport. Other is total minus marine products, aluminium, and foreign travellers; it includes non-aluminium manufacturing. Values do not identify export volumes, capacity or foreign-currency unit prices.

records.label: trade-weighted index relative to 2025 mean
records.notes: Candidate initial exchangeRate only after basket choice, prehistory and consistent valuation of FX assets and liabilities. Model chart uses inverse, 1/exchangeRate, so its direction differs.

records.label: Net international investment position
records.notes: Preliminary observation. All external assets minus liabilities; broader than model pension-fund foreign assets and central-bank reserves.

records.label: Deposit-taking corporations' total assets
records.modelMapping: B asset scope comparator; all deposit takers, not just three O-SIIs
records.notes: Preliminary parent-company balance sheet. Book equity divided by assets is not the risk-weighted regulatory capital ratio.

records.label: Deposit-taking corporations' book equity
records.modelMapping: B balance-sheet net worth; distinct from regulatory capital numerator
records.notes: Preliminary parent-company balance sheet. Book equity divided by assets is not the risk-weighted regulatory capital ratio.

records.label: Bank loans to non-financial corporations
records.modelMapping: businessLoans held by B; loansTot starts from an assumed 55% share of broader corporate debt
records.notes: All currencies. Not all corporate liabilities, foreign lending, bonds or intercompany borrowing.

records.label: Three systemically important banks' capital ratio
records.modelMapping: bankCapital; kapT = 22% assumed target and kapMin = 18% assumed pricing trigger
records.notes: Combined regulatory capital ratio adjusted for just over 37 bn of H1 profit dividends to be distributed in 2027. Different numerator and scope from all deposit takers' book equity; minimum overall requirements range 19.5–20% by bank.

records.label: Deposit takers' ESA debt-securities liabilities
records.modelMapping: B issued debt-securities comparator; not bank equity or deposits
records.notes: Latest annual THJ10001 observation available at cutoff: preliminary 2024, ESA 2010 non-consolidated sector accounts. Total financial liabilities include equity and pension commitments where applicable. NFC loan liabilities include intercompany debt and have broader scope than Financial Stability credit-market borrowing. Published rounded net positions may differ by 0.001 bn from subtracting rounded totals.

records.label: CBI 5-year indexed constant-maturity par yield
records.modelMapping: Market yield comparator for bond funding; not existing rBI0 coupon, sB spread or total portfolio return
records.notes: Latest row available in the retrieved workbook is 29 September. Interpolated constant-maturity par yield from market bonds; an indexed yield excludes future CPI indexation. A bond's yield to maturity differs from its contracted coupon and from its realised holding-period return.

records.label: CBI 5-year nominal constant-maturity par yield
records.modelMapping: Market yield comparator for bond funding; not existing rBI0 coupon, sB spread or total portfolio return
records.notes: Latest row available in the retrieved workbook is 29 September. Interpolated constant-maturity par yield from market bonds; an indexed yield excludes future CPI indexation. A bond's yield to maturity differs from its contracted coupon and from its realised holding-period return.

records.label: Landsbankinn preferred loan/bond base rate
records.modelMapping: businessLoanRate = keyRate + sL; sL = 2.5 percentage points assumed
records.notes: Non-indexed preferred base before borrower risk-class margins; not the corporate loan-book average. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: CBI official foreign-exchange reserves
records.modelMapping: fxr = 18% GDP placeholder; reserve instrument start
records.notes: CBI own balance sheet; official reserves exclude other foreign assets. Currency and counterparty scope must match before replacing a model account.

records.label: CBI government-bond asset
records.modelMapping: bondCB = 1% GDP placeholder
records.notes: CBI own balance sheet; official reserves exclude other foreign assets. Currency and counterparty scope must match before replacing a model account.

records.label: CBI equity including estimated year-to-date result
records.modelMapping: eqCB = 2% GDP placeholder
records.notes: Sum of capital/other equity and estimated annual result before Treasury contribution. Capital/other equity alone is 76.67920418 bn, and estimated annual loss is 37.87247843 bn.

records.label: Treasury/government foreign-exchange term deposits at CBI
records.modelMapping: Separate currency funding; not the ISK Treasury account
records.notes: CBI own balance sheet; official reserves exclude other foreign assets. Currency and counterparty scope must match before replacing a model account.

records.label: Treasury ISK current account at the CBI
records.modelMapping: tga = 5% GDP placeholder; Treasury-account scope
records.notes: CBI own balance sheet; official reserves exclude other foreign assets. Currency and counterparty scope must match before replacing a model account.

records.label: Central Treasury A1 foreign debt
records.modelMapping: Latest scope comparator; not a replacement for general-government govDebt
records.notes: Debt Management September bulletin, printed pages 4–5. A1 excludes local government, broader public entities, pension commitments and accounts payable. Its GDP percentages use the CBI's latest forecast calendar-year GDP, not last published trailing-four-quarter GDP.

records.label: Central Treasury A1 domestic indexed debt
records.modelMapping: Latest scope comparator; not a replacement for general-government govDebt
records.notes: Debt Management September bulletin, printed pages 4–5. A1 excludes local government, broader public entities, pension commitments and accounts payable. Its GDP percentages use the CBI's latest forecast calendar-year GDP, not last published trailing-four-quarter GDP.

records.label: Deposit takers' share of corporate credit-market debt
records.modelMapping: loansTot and assumed bank share: scope comparator, not all ESA corporate liabilities
records.notes: I-34 covers NFC debt to domestic/foreign financial corporations and issued market bonds at constant prices. Shares are rounded separately and sum to 99.99%; they do not certify an exact total debt amount. Intercompany borrowing in annual ESA loan liabilities has a different scope.

records.label: Arion ordinary current-account deposit
records.modelMapping: depositRate = keyRate − mD; mD = 1 percentage point assumed
records.notes: Ordinary unindexed current account; rewards accounts differ. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Íslandsbanki ordinary debit-account deposit
records.modelMapping: depositRate = keyRate − mD; mD = 1 percentage point assumed
records.notes: Ordinary unindexed debit account. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Landsbankinn ordinary current-account deposit
records.modelMapping: depositRate = keyRate − mD; mD = 1 percentage point assumed
records.notes: Ordinary unindexed current account. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Arion three-month Growth fixed-interest deposit
records.modelMapping: depositRate product comparator, not average of deposits
records.notes: Unindexed, three-month binding. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Íslandsbanki three-month fixed deposit
records.modelMapping: depositRate product comparator, not average of deposits
records.notes: Unindexed, three-month binding; balance ISK 100,000–1 bn. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Landsbankinn three-month fixed deposit
records.modelMapping: depositRate product comparator, not average of deposits
records.notes: Unindexed, three-month binding. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Current weighted rate paid on all deposits
records.modelMapping: depositRate and mD
records.notes: No directly verified current aggregate with the required product/indexation/cohort weights was obtained. Named rate sheets are evidence of current products, not this average. CBI bank-rate metadata describes high/low selected quoted rates; those are not an outstanding-loan balance-weighted mean.

records.label: General-government deposits at deposit takers
records.modelMapping: Government banking deposits; not just the Treasury account at the CBI
records.notes: Preliminary month-end parent-company deposit-taking-corporation statistics; Central Bank excluded. Sector and currency coverage must match before replacing model stocks.

records.label: Household deposits at deposit takers
records.modelMapping: HY/HW/HO deposits; hhDep uses 2025 tax-return scope
records.notes: Preliminary month-end parent-company deposit-taking-corporation statistics; Central Bank excluded. Sector and currency coverage must match before replacing model stocks.

records.label: Non-financial corporation deposits
records.modelMapping: Deposits of domestic and exporting FIRMS, before within-firm allocation
records.notes: Preliminary month-end parent-company deposit-taking-corporation statistics; Central Bank excluded. Sector and currency coverage must match before replacing model stocks.

records.label: NPISH deposits at deposit takers
records.modelMapping: No separate NPISH model sector
records.notes: Preliminary month-end parent-company deposit-taking-corporation statistics; Central Bank excluded. Sector and currency coverage must match before replacing model stocks.

records.label: Non-resident deposits at deposit takers
records.modelMapping: depW scope comparator; all currencies, not necessarily only foreign investors' ISK accounts
records.notes: Preliminary month-end parent-company deposit-taking-corporation statistics; Central Bank excluded. Sector and currency coverage must match before replacing model stocks.

records.label: Pension-fund sector deposits reported by deposit takers
records.modelMapping: deposits held by PF; reconcile with PF's own balance sheet before mapping
records.notes: Preliminary month-end parent-company deposit-taking-corporation statistics; Central Bank excluded. Sector and currency coverage must match before replacing model stocks.

records.label: All deposit-taking corporations' deposits
records.modelMapping: Bank deposits, including non-residents
records.notes: Preliminary month-end parent-company deposit-taking-corporation statistics; Central Bank excluded. Sector and currency coverage must match before replacing model stocks.

records.label: CBI official reserve assets in US dollars
records.modelMapping: fxr instrument scope comparator in USD; model monetary reporting uses ISK
records.notes: Non-empty original semicolon-separated CSV, monthly NSDP series NSDP.EXS.BPINRE.XXX.USD.IS.N.M. The 8/1/2026 timestamp labels August's monthly period; reserves are an end-month stock, not an August 1 daily quote. Official reserves include gold, SDR and the IMF reserve position as well as foreign-currency assets. Publication date is the CBI international-reserves calendar for August, rather than the September 7 own-balance-sheet release.

records.label: General-government securities + loans borrowing debt
records.modelMapping: govDebtAmount; govDebt parameter 56.7% rounded annual ratio
records.notes: Exact sum 1849.178 + 951.516 = 2800.694 bn. Model starts at 2801.666637 bn because it multiplies rounded 56.7% by 4941.211 bn GDP. The model's bond-only instruments represent this broader securities-and-loans calibration.

records.label: Exact borrowing amount / exact calendar-2025 GDP
records.modelMapping: Exact-stock alternative to the rounded 56.7% baseline calibration
records.notes: This transparent calculation preserves the exact 2800.694 bn securities-and-loans stock. The annual GDP denominator is the latest 2025 nominal-GDP vintage verified by the macro audit.

records.label: General-government net financial assets
records.modelMapping: govDebt/Amount only use securities + loans as a simplified bond instrument; other liabilities are separate
records.notes: ESA 2010 general government, including central and local government and reclassified public funds. Latest annual observation, not a September 2026 stock.

records.label: Household ESA debt-securities assets
records.modelMapping: HY/HW/HO financial balance sheets; include pensionRights when comparing net worth
records.notes: Latest annual table available at cutoff is preliminary 2024, ESA 2010 non-consolidated S.14 households. Model balanceSheet(HW/HO) does include pension rights; cash-wealth spending rules use narrower liquid savings. Do not add 2025 tax real estate to 2024 financial assets and call the result current market net wealth.

records.label: Household ESA equity and fund-unit assets
records.modelMapping: HY/HW/HO financial balance sheets; include pensionRights when comparing net worth
records.notes: Latest annual table available at cutoff is preliminary 2024, ESA 2010 non-consolidated S.14 households. Model balanceSheet(HW/HO) does include pension rights; cash-wealth spending rules use narrower liquid savings. Do not add 2025 tax real estate to 2024 financial assets and call the result current market net wealth.

records.label: Household ESA net financial assets
records.modelMapping: HY/HW/HO financial balance sheets; include pensionRights when comparing net worth
records.notes: Latest annual table available at cutoff is preliminary 2024, ESA 2010 non-consolidated S.14 households. Model balanceSheet(HW/HO) does include pension rights; cash-wealth spending rules use narrower liquid savings. Do not add 2025 tax real estate to 2024 financial assets and call the result current market net wealth.

records.label: Household ESA insurance and pension assets
records.modelMapping: HY/HW/HO financial balance sheets; include pensionRights when comparing net worth
records.notes: Latest annual table available at cutoff is preliminary 2024, ESA 2010 non-consolidated S.14 households. Model balanceSheet(HW/HO) does include pension rights; cash-wealth spending rules use narrower liquid savings. Do not add 2025 tax real estate to 2024 financial assets and call the result current market net wealth.

records.label: Tax-family 67+ share of household deposits
records.unit: % of all tax families' corresponding stock
records.modelMapping: hhDep age allocation
records.notes: Derived tax-family-age share, not a current bank borrower/customer-age observation. Young age band includes under-18 tax families as well as ages 18–34; transferring these shares to 2026 bank totals assumes an unchanged composition.

records.label: Tax-family 35–66 share of household deposits
records.unit: % of all tax families' corresponding stock
records.modelMapping: hhDep age allocation
records.notes: Derived tax-family-age share, not a current bank borrower/customer-age observation. Young age band includes under-18 tax families as well as ages 18–34; transferring these shares to 2026 bank totals assumes an unchanged composition.

records.label: Tax-family under 35 share of household deposits
records.unit: % of all tax families' corresponding stock
records.modelMapping: hhDep age allocation
records.notes: Derived tax-family-age share, not a current bank borrower/customer-age observation. Young age band includes under-18 tax families as well as ages 18–34; transferring these shares to 2026 bank totals assumes an unchanged composition.

records.label: Tax-family under 35 share of household mortgagedebt
records.unit: % of all tax families' corresponding stock
records.modelMapping: mshY/W/O borrower-age allocation
records.notes: Derived tax-family-age share, not a current bank borrower/customer-age observation. Young age band includes under-18 tax families as well as ages 18–34; transferring these shares to 2026 bank totals assumes an unchanged composition.

records.label: Tax-family 67+ share of household realestate
records.unit: % of all tax families' corresponding stock
records.modelMapping: hshY/W/O ownership/value comparator
records.notes: Derived tax-family-age share, not a current bank borrower/customer-age observation. Young age band includes under-18 tax families as well as ages 18–34; transferring these shares to 2026 bank totals assumes an unchanged composition.

records.label: Tax-family 35–66 share of household realestate
records.unit: % of all tax families' corresponding stock
records.modelMapping: hshY/W/O ownership/value comparator
records.notes: Derived tax-family-age share, not a current bank borrower/customer-age observation. Young age band includes under-18 tax families as well as ages 18–34; transferring these shares to 2026 bank totals assumes an unchanged composition.

records.label: Tax-family under 35 share of household realestate
records.unit: % of all tax families' corresponding stock
records.modelMapping: hshY/W/O ownership/value comparator
records.notes: Derived tax-family-age share, not a current bank borrower/customer-age observation. Young age band includes under-18 tax families as well as ages 18–34; transferring these shares to 2026 bank totals assumes an unchanged composition.

records.label: CBI inflation target
records.modelMapping: Official context for piT; model piT = 0 is a stationary-baseline assumption
records.notes: Target is an annual CPI inflation rate, not today's inflation observation or a price-index level.

records.label: First-time buyer maximum mortgage debt service / income
records.modelMapping: dstiY; legal assessment setting, with age/buyer-status approximation where relevant
records.notes: First-time means never previously a registered owner of residential property, regardless of age. Mixed first-time/other owners receive a proportional 35% + (n/m) × 5 percentage-point cap. The model applies 40% to the young group as a proxy, not a statutory age rule. Rules 1300/2025 remain listed in force in the CBI register at cutoff; no later replacement was identified. Signed 2 December, published/effective 3 December 2025, replacing 1130/2025. Caps apply at origination under the legal borrower/income definitions, not an observed loan-book average.

records.label: General maximum mortgage debt service / income
records.modelMapping: dstiW; legal assessment setting, with age/buyer-status approximation where relevant
records.notes: Each lender may grant above-cap lending up to 10% of the previous quarter's total mortgage amount (Article 5). Temporary 40% treatment applies to qualifying owners of Grindavík homes on 10 November 2023 buying their next home, until 1 March 2027. Financial-distress refinancing is excluded by Article 1. Rules 1300/2025 remain listed in force in the CBI register at cutoff; no later replacement was identified. Signed 2 December, published/effective 3 December 2025, replacing 1130/2025. Caps apply at origination under the legal borrower/income definitions, not an observed loan-book average.

records.label: Arion new indexed mortgage
records.unit: % per year, indexed coupon excluding CPI
records.modelMapping: mortgageRateI; rMI0 = 2.5% assumed real coupon
records.notes: Fixed for three years, portion within 50% LTV; CPI indexation increases principal separately. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Íslandsbanki new indexed mortgage
records.unit: % per year, indexed coupon excluding CPI
records.modelMapping: mortgageRateI; rMI0 = 2.5% assumed real coupon
records.notes: Fixed for five years, portion within 50% LTV; CPI indexation increases principal separately. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: Landsbankinn new indexed mortgage
records.unit: % per year, indexed coupon excluding CPI
records.modelMapping: mortgageRateI; rMI0 = 2.5% assumed real coupon
records.notes: Fixed for loan life, up to 75% LTV; CPI indexation increases principal separately. Named advertised product, not an institution-weighted rate on outstanding loans. LTV tier, indexation and reset term matter. PDF date is the rate-sheet/effective date; a separate publication date was not established.

records.label: First-time buyer additional mortgage LTV allowance
records.unit: percentage points of property market value
records.modelMapping: ltvYExtra; legal eligibility is not identical to the model's age groups
records.notes: Difference between the statutory 90% first-time and 80% general caps. For mixed-owner eligibility, only the first-time-owner fraction receives this increment. It is not the DSTI lender's 10% quarterly exemption. Rules 1131/2025 remain listed in force in the CBI register at cutoff; no later replacement was identified. Signed 31 October, published/effective 3 November 2025, replacing 217/2024. Caps apply at mortgage origination against the property's legally defined market value. Temporary 85% treatment applies to qualifying Grindavík owners buying their next home until 1 March 2027; financial-distress refinancing is excluded under Article 1.

records.label: General maximum mortgage loan / property value
records.modelMapping: ltvLimit; legal eligibility is not identical to the model's age groups
records.notes: Property value is the purchase agreement/accepted offer, or the prescribed assessment/appraisal fallback. This is a legal maximum, not average LTV on new or existing loans. Rules 1131/2025 remain listed in force in the CBI register at cutoff; no later replacement was identified. Signed 31 October, published/effective 3 November 2025, replacing 217/2024. Caps apply at mortgage origination against the property's legally defined market value. Temporary 85% treatment applies to qualifying Grindavík owners buying their next home until 1 March 2027; financial-distress refinancing is excluded under Article 1.

records.label: Simple mean of three banks' low-LTV floating mortgage quotes
records.modelMapping: mortgageRateN display context; not a calibrated outstanding-loan mean
records.notes: Arithmetic mean of the three named product rows. It has no balances/weights; Landsbankinn's 90% eligible product and other banks' 50% base tier are not identical products. Do not present as the national mortgage rate.

records.label: Indexed mortgage debt-service test coupon floor
records.modelMapping: floorI; legal assessment setting, with age/buyer-status approximation where relevant
records.notes: Use the actual contractual indexed rate when it is higher. CPI indexation is separate; this is an indexed coupon assessment floor, not current inflation or an observed real investment return. Rules 1300/2025 remain listed in force in the CBI register at cutoff; no later replacement was identified. Signed 2 December, published/effective 3 December 2025, replacing 1130/2025. Caps apply at origination under the legal borrower/income definitions, not an observed loan-book average.

records.label: Non-indexed mortgage debt-service test rate floor
records.modelMapping: floorN; legal assessment setting, with age/buyer-status approximation where relevant
records.notes: Use the actual contractual rate when it is higher. This is a debt-service test floor, not a quoted mortgage rate, neutral rate or rate cap. Rules 1300/2025 remain listed in force in the CBI register at cutoff; no later replacement was identified. Signed 2 December, published/effective 3 December 2025, replacing 1130/2025. Caps apply at origination under the legal borrower/income definitions, not an observed loan-book average.

records.label: Indexed mortgage debt-service test maximum term
records.modelMapping: termI; legal assessment setting, with age/buyer-status approximation where relevant
records.notes: The assessment may use equal payments and this maximum term independently of the actual loan contract. This is not a measured average loan maturity or a universal contractual term limit. Rules 1300/2025 remain listed in force in the CBI register at cutoff; no later replacement was identified. Signed 2 December, published/effective 3 December 2025, replacing 1130/2025. Caps apply at origination under the legal borrower/income definitions, not an observed loan-book average.

records.label: Non-indexed mortgage debt-service test maximum term
records.modelMapping: termN; legal assessment setting, with age/buyer-status approximation where relevant
records.notes: The assessment may use equal payments and this maximum term independently of the actual loan contract. This is not a measured average loan maturity or a universal contractual term limit. Rules 1300/2025 remain listed in force in the CBI register at cutoff; no later replacement was identified. Signed 2 December, published/effective 3 December 2025, replacing 1130/2025. Caps apply at origination under the legal borrower/income definitions, not an observed loan-book average.

records.label: Current all-lender household residential mortgage stock
records.modelMapping: mortgageDebtAmount broad lender-scope start
records.notes: Bank and PF July total is verified. A common-date addition for HMS/ÍL and any remaining mortgage lenders was not directly verified; retain this gap rather than substituting total household debt.

records.label: Bank foreign-currency residential mortgage stock
records.modelMapping: Mortgage debt instruments only for rows named residential; all-household loans are broader
records.notes: Gross outstanding principal at month end. Indexed principal already incorporates CPI indexation. Bank sector excludes pension funds and other mortgage lenders.

records.label: Bank indexed residential mortgage stock
records.modelMapping: Mortgage debt instruments only for rows named residential; all-household loans are broader
records.notes: Gross outstanding principal at month end. Indexed principal already incorporates CPI indexation. Bank sector excludes pension funds and other mortgage lenders.

records.label: Bank non-indexed ISK residential mortgage stock
records.modelMapping: Mortgage debt instruments only for rows named residential; all-household loans are broader
records.notes: Gross outstanding principal at month end. Indexed principal already incorporates CPI indexation. Bank sector excludes pension funds and other mortgage lenders.

records.label: Pension-fund indexed residential mortgage stock
records.modelMapping: pfMortI/N only for residential rows; all PF lending is broader
records.notes: The aggregate PF all-loan stock 859.433 bn includes companies, municipalities and non-residents; it must not be called household mortgage debt.

records.label: Pension-fund non-indexed residential mortgage stock
records.modelMapping: pfMortI/N only for residential rows; all PF lending is broader
records.notes: The aggregate PF all-loan stock 859.433 bn includes companies, municipalities and non-residents; it must not be called household mortgage debt.

records.label: Company net new lending, three-month moving average
records.unit: bn ISK per month, three-month moving average
records.modelMapping: Broad company credit-flow context; not one month's bank lending or investment
records.notes: Monetary Bulletin 2026/3 chart 6: new lending net of prepayments and retirement of older loans; deposit takers, PF, HMS, ÍL and Fossar. The chart states bn ISK and smoothing but no price-adjustment reference; no constant-price claim is made. Different from Financial Stability I-33's constant-price components and from nominal, unsmoothed bank-only August lending. Do not divide this monthly moving average by 12 again.

records.label: Household net new lending, three-month moving average
records.unit: bn ISK per month, three-month moving average
records.modelMapping: Household all-purpose credit-flow context; not mortgage-only lending
records.notes: Monetary Bulletin 2026/3 chart 6: new lending net of prepayments and retirement of older loans; deposit takers, PF, HMS, ÍL and Fossar. The chart states bn ISK and smoothing but no price-adjustment reference; no constant-price claim is made. Different from Financial Stability I-33's constant-price components and from nominal, unsmoothed bank-only August lending. Do not divide this monthly moving average by 12 again.

records.label: Net new household mortgage lending
records.unit: bn ISK per month, constant prices (base not stated)
records.modelMapping: netMortgageLending / netMortgage / creditImpulse context; reconcile contractual amortisation, lender scope, price basis and annual-rate-to-month conversion
records.notes: Freshly retained official chart workbook I-30. New lending less debt retirement and prepayments in excess of contractual requirements; includes deposit institutions, pension funds, HMS and ÍL. Both workbook and report specify constant prices but do not state the reference date in this chart. The bank new-credit definition excludes scheduled amortisation from prepayments, while the model's mortgageRepayment includes scheduled amortisation and loans retired on sale; an exact principal-flow match therefore requires reconciliation. It is not certified nominal July cash flow and is not the mortgage-stock change, which also includes CPI indexation. Do not divide this already-monthly flow by 12 again.

records.label: Pension-fund total assets
records.modelMapping: pfAssets; baseline 179.7% of 2025 GDP
records.notes: Latest preliminary pension-fund monthly balance sheet available by cutoff; next scheduled release 7 October. Foreign funds' underlying bond/share mix is not identifiable from the legal-instrument fund-unit row.

records.label: Domestic mutual + personal pension cash benefits/withdrawals
records.modelMapping: Broader annual domestic pension cash payouts; differs from mutual-only calibration and model pensionPayouts
records.notes: 309.263731835 + 52.245838799 = 361.509570634 bn. Covers mutual and domestic personal departments including non-fund custodians, excluding foreign providers. PAYE private/occupational withdrawals of 346.827 bn use another tax/recipient scope; they are not a confirmation or correction of this fund/custodian accounting total. Annual 2025 fund accounts, released 25 June 2026. Mutual covers all mutual departments; domestic personal covers personal departments at funds and other domestic custodians. Foreign custodians are reported separately and are excluded here. Workbook unit thousand ISK / 1,000,000 = bn ISK. These flows are not the PAYE recipient/withdrawal aggregate or the model's solved stationary pensionPayouts flow.

records.label: Pension-fund domestic shares and fund units
records.modelMapping: PF domestic equity instruments; fund units need look-through mapping
records.notes: Latest preliminary pension-fund monthly balance sheet available by cutoff; next scheduled release 7 October. Foreign funds' underlying bond/share mix is not identifiable from the legal-instrument fund-unit row.

records.label: Pension funds' ESA financial assets
records.modelMapping: PF financial assets, distinct from monthly total assets including non-financial assets
records.notes: Latest annual THJ10001 observation available at cutoff: preliminary 2024, ESA 2010 non-consolidated sector accounts. Total financial liabilities include equity and pension commitments where applicable. NFC loan liabilities include intercompany debt and have broader scope than Financial Stability credit-market borrowing. Published rounded net positions may differ by 0.001 bn from subtracting rounded totals.

records.label: Pension-fund foreign assets
records.modelMapping: foreignAssets held by PF
records.notes: Latest preliminary pension-fund monthly balance sheet available by cutoff; next scheduled release 7 October. Foreign funds' underlying bond/share mix is not identifiable from the legal-instrument fund-unit row.

records.label: Pension-fund foreign share
records.modelMapping: pfForeignShare and pfForeignTarget
records.notes: Derived foreign assets / total assets; Financial Stability 2026/2 rounds this to 42%. Model uses 41.5% at end 2025.

records.label: Pension funds' ESA net financial assets
